title: Panzer Island - A reactive turn based strategy game - built with help from Claude
author: rhedak
selftext:
Dear Fellow Devs, 

I would like some feedback on my game Panzer Island. Even with help from AI I spent about six months developing it. 

Ai helped with coding and with drawing most art assets using matplotlib (python). The game itself it built with Godot (GDScript) with a combination go AI code and manual scene building / stage building via a stage editor. 

The game is live on itch, Steam and Google Play and I also build a github pages website for it with help from Claude, including a more detailed writeup how I used AI tools. 

The first chapter is free on any platform and I'll gladly provide a free key if you do a playtest and send me your feedback. 

You can find everything here and feel free to ask any questions. 

[https://rhedak.github.io/panzer\_island\_pages/​](https://rhedak.github.io/panzer_island_pages/​)

replies.author: rhedak
replies.body: Thank you! It should work now.
